maddeler.e:
أستوقح (form X)
# أَسْتَوْقِحُ (ʔastawqiḥu) /ʔas.taw.qi.ħu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَوْقَحَ (istawqaḥa)
# أَسْتَوْقِحَ (ʔastawqiḥa) /ʔas.taw.qi.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَوْقَحَ (istawqaḥa)
# أَسْتَوْقِحْ (ʔastawqiḥ) /ʔas.taw.qiħ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَوْقَحَ (istawqaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
